name: team_code with no row axis still resolves to the current-team snapshot
description: Negative control for team-code-year-axis-uses-historical-team. source.supports_row_axes widens what the column may receive, it does not make the year bridge unconditional: with no row axis there is no season to attribute to, so team_code must keep resolving through the player_teams snapshot (ARRAY[current_nfl_team]) and must not drag in the player_years_teams gamelog scan. This fixture turns red if get_player_bridge stops discriminating on row_axes.
expected_query: with "player_teams" as (SELECT pid, ARRAY[current_nfl_team]::text[] AS teams FROM player WHERE current_nfl_team IS NOT NULL AND current_nfl_team <> 'INA') select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, player_teams.teams as team_code_0, "player"."primary_position" from "player" left join "player_teams" on "player_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" group by player.first_name, player.last_name, player_teams.teams, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by "player"."pid" asc limit 5
